data.one_liner: A Flutter package exposing the Lucide icon set with multiple stroke weights and RTL support.
data.what_it_does: It provides Dart classes for every Lucide icon, letting you use them as regular Flutter Icon widgets. Icons are split into modular libraries per stroke weight to keep compile size low and support right‑to‑left layouts.
use_when: You need a comprehensive, ready‑made vector icon set for Flutter apps.
You want to choose different stroke weights or need RTL‑aware icons.
You prefer a single dependency rather than managing SVG assets yourself.
avoid_when: You require animated or interactive icons beyond static vectors.
You need a custom icon set that isn’t covered by Lucide.
strengths: Modular weight libraries reduce bundle size and improve IDE autocomplete
Simple API, works like the built‑in Icon widget
Supports RTL variants out of the box
weaknesses: Only provides static icons – no animation support
Adds a dependency even if only a few icons are used

alternatives.name: font_awesome_flutter
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides a similarly large, well‑known icon set with a single package and no weight modularization needed.
